title: A Trip to the Market
text:
Tom goes to the market on Sunday. He wants to buy apples, carrots and a loaf of bread. The market is full of people and the prices are low. He finds the best apples at the fruit stand.

After he pays, Tom walks home with a big bag. The bread is still warm, so he smells it on the way. At home, he puts the apples in a bowl. He thinks the trip was very good.

He is happy with the trip

questions.text: Why does Tom smell the bread on the way home?
options: He wants to find a new shop
He is hungry and the bread is fresh
He does not like the smell
He wants to share it with a dog

the amount of money you must pay for things
sweet food from plants, such as apples or oranges
a little hot, but not very hot

paragraph_translations: Tom idzie na targ w niedzielę. Chce kupić jabłka, marchewki i bochenek chleba. Targ jest pełen ludzi, a ceny są niskie. Najlepsze jabłka znajduje przy straganie z owocami.
Po zapłaceniu Tom wraca do domu z dużą torbą. Chleb jest jeszcze ciepły, więc wącha go po drodze. W domu wkłada jabłka do miski. Uważa, że wycieczka była bardzo udana.
